explanation: The main character in the book and leader of the Israelites after Moses' death, who led them into the promised land.
A binding agreement or commitment between two parties, here between God and the Israelites.
To obey and follow an authority, in this case God, and carry out his will.
False gods or objects that people worship instead of the true God.
Those who came before us in the family line, especially those who founded the nation of Israel, such as Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
A declaration from God to give something specific to someone, in this case the land of Canaan to the Israelites.
Persons or things that confirm the truth of an event or statement; here used of heaven and earth as witnesses against the Israelites if they break their covenant with God.
To make a decision or take a stand, here regarding whether to serve God or other gods.
